propDocs.Carousel.orientation: Horizontal or vertical scrolling and arrow-key direction.
propDocs.Carousel.align: Align each page to start, center or end.
propDocs.Carousel.slidesPerPage: Number of slides each next/previous press advances.
propDocs.Carousel.loop: Wrap around between the first and last pages.
propDocs.Carousel.skipSnaps: Let fast swipes pass multiple pages.
propDocs.Carousel.dragFree: Allow dragging to coast between snap points.
propDocs.Carousel.drag: Enable dragging, swiping and wheel scrolling.
propDocs.Carousel.playing: Automatically rotate pages; interaction can pause rotation.
